title: aragallus campestris
intro: Aragallus campestris, commonly known as Field Milk Thistle, is a flowering plant in the borage family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, primarily for its health benefits, which include liver protection and detoxification. The therapeutic actions of Aragallus campestris include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective properties, making it useful in treating liver and gallbladder disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
